The united tauren tribes are a nation formed by the tauren tribes of Kalimdor and acting as a member state of the Horde. Once led by High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof, the nomadic tauren founded Thunder Bluff as their capital in the windswept mesa of Mulgore, where they united under a single banner to protect their new home. It was Cairne's vision of a peaceful home for all tauren tribes that led to the unification of the formerly disparate race. Currently under the leadership of High Chieftain Baine Bloodhoof, the tauren of Mulgore live honorable lives and value peace over the warmongering ways of their allies, striving to preserve the balance of nature and heed the will of their goddess, the

The Unnamed Khanam Dochra, or "Favoured Daughter", was heir to the Khanam in a time of strife between dragons. She led a caravan on a diplomatic endeavor to Iskaara territory near Traitor's Rest at the behest of tuskarr leaders. There the tuskarr requested martial support against an anticipated attack from Neltharion, but the Maruukai refused to help, believing that their involvement would only make them enemies of dragonkind. As the Dochra and her caravan traveled back to their territory, they were wiped out by a vicious storm. Her corpse was found thousands of years later during an excavation by an adventurer and Roska Rocktooth in the riverbed between Maruukai and Cloverwood Hollow. Tigar

Upper Deck Entertainment (UDE) is a division of the . Active during the mid-2000s, UDE focused on licensed non-sports card games, including World of Warcraft. From 2006 to 2010, Upper Deck Entertainment published the World of Warcraft Trading Card Game and the World of Warcraft Miniatures Game in partnership with Blizzard Entertainment. The TCG game adapted content from the MMORPG into turn-based card battles, with formats including traditional matches and cooperative "raid decks". UDE introduced "loot cards" offering digital rewards, helping bridge online and physical gameplay. Their license ended in March 2010, having not been renewed, and would later be transferred to Cryptozoic Entertain

Valiant Trainees are aspirant kyrian located in Xandria's Vigil in Bastion. Many of them are found dead, scattered around the Temple of Courage, killed by the Maldraxxi invaders.
